name: gecm-academics-erp-portal
description: GECM ACADEMICS — Government Engineering College Madhubani Academic Management & ERP Portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
